children: Teledyne FLIR, part of Teledyne Technologies Incorporated (NYSE:TDY), today announced that its FLIR A40, A50 and A70 (Axx-Series) thermal imaging cameras are the first models to achieve UL 2684 listing. This new classification brings certified early detection thermal imaging into code-compliant fire detection and alarm systems, a significant expansion in early identification and response capabilities in the fire mitigation industry.

The UL 2684 listing allows engineers, system designers and facility operators to incorporate Axx-Series cameras into fire detection systems designed in accordance with NFPA 72, which expands the role of thermal imaging beyond preventative maintenance and condition monitoring into certified early fire detection applications. By detecting abnormal heat signatures before smoke or flames develop, these cameras provide earlier warning of potential fire events, helping facilities respond more quickly while protecting people, property and critical operations.

Unlike conventional smoke or heat detectors that generally respond after combustion has begun, Axx-Series cameras continuously monitor equipment, assets and large areas for developing thermal anomalies. When predefined alarm conditions are met, the cameras can initiate fire alarm events through compatible control systems, enabling faster response while helping reduce the risk of fire escalation. By using a single camera to monitor multiple assets or large areas, Axx-Series cameras simplify system design for data centers, warehouses and distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, utility and energy infrastructure, and other commercial and industrial applications requiring rapid thermal event detection.

"UL 2684 listing marks a major milestone for the fire protection industry," said Mattias Walan, General Manager of Advanced and Integrated Solutions at Teledyne FLIR. "For the first time, thermal imaging can be incorporated into code-compliant fire detection systems using cameras specifically evaluated to this standard. This gives engineers, system integrators and end users a new tool for identifying developing fire risks earlier and protecting critical assets."
For more information about Axx-Series thermal imaging cameras and Teledyne FLIR’s early fire detection solutions, visit flir.com/fire-life-safety.

Teledyne FLIR, a subsidiary of Teledyne Technologies, is a world leader in intelligent sensing solutions for defense and industrial applications. Founded in 1978, the company creates advanced technologies that help professionals make better, faster decisions that save lives and livelihoods. Teledyne FLIR provides a diverse portfolio of thermal imaging, visible-light imaging, video analytics, measurement and diagnostic, and advanced threat detection systems serving customers across industrial, commercial, public safety, and defense markets. For more information, visit Teledyne FLIR’s website at flir.com.

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated is a leading provider of sophisticated digital imaging products and software, instrumentation, aerospace and defense electronics, and engineered systems. Teledyne’s operations are primarily located in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Western and Northern Europe. For more information, visit Teledyne’s website at teledyne.com.
